title: Extending a word assignment by one tape
statement: Let $L>0$ and let $s,y$ be Boolean words. Assigning the word $s$ to tape zero among the first $L$ tapes and the word $y$ to the additional last tape gives the tape layout in which tape zero stores $s$, tape $L$ stores $y$, and every intervening tape is blank.
replaced:
Appending one tape holding a word $y$ to a bank of $L$ tapes whose only nonblank
tape is tape zero holding $s$ yields exactly the two-ended tape layout: tape
zero $s$, last tape $y$, all intervening tapes blank.
